Class Builder

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Character
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.characters.Builder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Builder extends Character
Represents a Builder card, a specific type of card that provides discounts and prestige points. Instances of this class are intended to be created from JSON data.
